claims.text: The experiments were conducted on a large number of language pairs spanning diverse language families and writing systems.
The experiments included a joint bilingual BPE model and analyzed the effects of various parameters on translation accuracy.
The number of merge operations for BPE was varied between 1000 to 4000 across different language pairs to study its effect on translation accuracy.
